fields.Name: T316 - Scheduling Edit Job Slideout
fields.Description: Exercises the editor's EDIT branch (existing-record load + Statistics section + Delete affordance), a different code path from the create branch and from generated forms.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Click on an existing job CARD (the body of the card, not its footer buttons). A slide-in editor should open pre-populated with that job's Name, Job Type, Cron Expression, Timezone and Concurrency, and — in edit mode — a footer with both a 'Save' and a 'Delete' button (and, if the job has runs, a Statistics section with Total/Succeeded/Failed counts). Success is the editor opening in edit mode with the job's values loaded and the Save+Delete footer showing. If NO job cards exist, seeing the 'Create your first scheduled job' empty state instead is acceptable. Close/Cancel afterward.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a job card opens the slide-in editor pre-filled with that job's values (Name, Cron Expression, etc.)
The editor is in edit mode: footer shows both Save and Delete (and a Statistics section if the job has run history) — OR, if no jobs exist, a valid empty-state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
